## LEAGUE mobile filter layout — findings

The LEAGUE view’s mobile filter UX is implemented almost entirely in one file, with page-level wiring and a small cross-cutting “compact chrome” flag for landscape.

---

### 1. Relevant files and components

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\pages\league\LeagueFilterBar.tsx` | **Main implementation** — all filter layouts |
| `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\pages\league\LeagueStats.tsx` | Page shell, URL params, mounts `LeagueFilterBar`, enables compact chrome |
| `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\context\MobileNavContext.tsx` | `leagueCompactChrome` flag for landscape merge |
| `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\components\Sidebar.tsx` | Global mobile top bar hidden when league compact chrome is active |
| `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\components\BottomSheet.tsx` | Shared overlay for drill-down filters |

**Exported / internal component names in `LeagueFilterBar.tsx`:**

- `LeagueFilterBar` — renders desktop + mobile variants together
- `FilterRailDesktop` — `lg+` sticky horizontal rail (all filters inline)
- `FilterBarMobile` — portrait + landscape mobile bars + bottom sheet
- `CompactSeasonLeagueFields` — label-less compact selects for landscape row
- `SeasonLeagueFields` — labeled Saison/Liga pair (portrait + desktop)
- `buildDrillDownSummary` — text summary of active week/team/round
- `FilterField`, `SelectControl` — **local** helpers (not shared across pages)

---

### 2. Fixed vs additional (drill-down) params

The codebase does not use the words “fixed” or “additional” in types, but the behavior matches that split:

**Fixed (always on the sticky bar when a league context exists):**

- `season` (Saison)
- `league` (Liga)

These are always visible on mobile in the sticky filter chrome via `SeasonLeagueFields` (portrait) or `CompactSeasonLeagueFields` (landscape). On desktop they are the first fields in `FilterRailDesktop`.

**Drill-down / “Weitere Auswahl” (week → team → round):**

- `week` (Spieltag)
- `team` (Mannschaft)
- `round` (Spiel) — only when `week` is set

On mobile, these live in a `BottomSheet` opened by “Weitere Auswahl” (portrait) or “Mehr” (landscape). The button only appears when `hasLeague` (`!!props.league`).

```117:117:c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\pages\league\LeagueFilterBar.tsx
  const hasDrillDown = !!(props.week || props.team || props.round);
```

Portrait shows an inline summary line when drill-down is active; landscape relies on the “Aktiv” badge on the button.

**Desktop** keeps everything in one rail, with progressive disclosure by selection state:

```45:47:c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\pages\league\LeagueFilterBar.tsx
  const showWeek = !!props.league;
  const showTeam = !!props.league;
  const showRound = !!props.week;
```

**URL param cascade** (in `LeagueStats.tsx`) — changing a parent clears children:

- Season change → drops `league`, `week`, `team`, `round`
- League change → drops `week`, `team`, `round`
- Week change → drops `round`
- Team change → drops `round`

---

### 3. Breakpoint and layout methodology

Three responsive modes, all via **Tailwind utility classes** (no separate CSS files for filters):

| Mode | Condition | What shows |
|------|-----------|------------|
| **Desktop** | `lg:` (≥1024px) | `FilterRailDesktop` — `hidden lg:block` |
| **Mobile portrait** | `< lg`, not landscape | `FilterBarMobile` portrait block — `max-lg:landscape:hidden lg:hidden` |
| **Mobile landscape** | `< lg` + landscape | `FilterBarMobile` landscape row — `hidden max-lg:landscape:flex lg:hidden` |

`max-lg:landscape:` is Tailwind’s built-in **landscape orientation** variant scoped to viewports below `lg`. No custom `@media` blocks in `index.css` for this.

**Portrait mobile** (`FilterBarMobile`):

- 2-column grid for Saison + Liga (`grid-cols-2`, taller `h-11` selects)
- Below: optional summary + full-width “Weitere Auswahl” button → `BottomSheet`

**Landscape mobile** (special treatment):

- Single horizontal row: **menu | title | compact Saison/Liga | Mehr**
- Merges what used to be Sidebar top bar + filter bar (see §4)
- Shorter button label, smaller controls (`h-8`, `text-[13px]`, `w-[min(7.5rem,24vw)]` selects)

**Container queries** on the landscape bar for progressive title collapse:

```142:166:c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\pages\league\LeagueFilterBar.tsx
    <motion.div className="@container/league-bar sticky top-0 z-20 ... max-lg:landscape:flex ...">
      ...
      <motion.div
        title={`${props.pageName} · ${props.pageHeading}`}
        className="flex min-w-0 shrink-[1000] ... @max-[22rem]/league-bar:pointer-events-none @max-[22rem]/league-bar:max-w-0 @max-[22rem]/league-bar:opacity-0"
      >
        <span className="... @max-[30rem]/league-bar:max-w-0 @max-[30rem]/league-bar:opacity-0">
          {props.pageName}
        </span>
        ...
        <span className="min-w-0 shrink truncate text-small font-semibold ...">
          {props.pageHeading}
        </span>
      </motion.div>
```

Narrow containers hide eyebrow (`pageName`) first, then the whole title block below ~22rem.

---

### 4. Landscape “compact chrome” coordination

`LeagueStats` sets `leagueCompactChrome` for the whole page visit:

```31:34:c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\pages\league\LeagueStats.tsx
  useEffect(() => {
    setLeagueCompactChrome(true);
    return () => setLeagueCompactChrome(false);
  }, [setLeagueCompactChrome]);
```

When true, `Sidebar` hides its global mobile top bar **only in landscape below lg**:

```100:104:c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\components\Sidebar.tsx
      <div
        className={
          "lg:hidden sticky top-0 z-30 flex items-center ... " +
          (leagueCompactChrome ? "max-lg:landscape:hidden" : "")
        }
```

The landscape filter row then provides its own hamburger via `openMobileNav()` from `useMobileNav()`.

`LeagueStats` also hides the large page header in landscape and tightens top padding:

```77:78:c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\pages\league\LeagueStats.tsx
    <motion.div className="mx-auto max-w-[1280px] px-4 pt-8 pb-24 max-lg:landscape:pt-2 lg:px-8 lg:pt-12">
      <header className="mb-6 max-lg:landscape:hidden lg:mb-8">
```

`pageName` / `pageHeading` props on `LeagueFilterBar` feed the in-bar title in landscape.

---

### 5. Shared primitives vs league-local code

**Shared:**

- `BottomSheet` — mobile-only wrapper (`lg:hidden`), backdrop, “Fertig” close, body scroll lock
- `MobileNavContext` / `MobileNavProvider` (in `App.tsx`) — drawer open/close + `leagueCompactChrome`
- Design tokens via Tailwind semantic classes (`border-border`, `bg-surface`, `text-muted`, etc.)

**League-local (not extracted to `components/`):**

- `FilterField`, `SelectControl` — duplicated pattern exists in `PlayerStats.tsx` / `TournamentStats.tsx` but as separate inline copies, not a shared module
- All landscape/portrait split logic is **only** on the league page

Player and tournament pages use a single desktop-style `FilterRail` without mobile bottom sheet or landscape merge.

### Summary

LEAGUE filters use a **three-tier responsive strategy**: desktop inline rail (`lg+`), mobile portrait (2-col Saison/Liga + bottom sheet for week/team/round), and mobile landscape (one merged sticky row with menu, truncated title, compact selects, and short “Mehr” button). **Fixed params** = season + league on the bar; **additional params** = week/team/round in `BottomSheet`. Landscape coordination relies on `max-lg:landscape:*` utilities, `@container/league-bar` truncation, and `leagueCompactChrome` to suppress the duplicate global mobile header in `Sidebar.tsx`.
